name: Slaves
overview: The Bible addresses the reality of slavery both as a social institution and as a spiritual metaphor. While Exodus 21:16 condemns the kidnapping and selling of people, emphasizing the sanctity of human life, passages like Ephesians 6:5 and Colossians 3:22 instruct servants to obey their earthly masters sincerely, as serving Christ. Spiritually, Jesus teaches in John 8:34 that all who sin are slaves to sin, highlighting the need for deliverance through Christ. Furthermore, Galatians 3:28 affirms that in Christ, distinctions such as slave and free are transcended, uniting all believers into one family.
